note: Lab clip 11, Find the Maroon Cap: the narrator only (af_heart). The test line n03 is its own line so the pause after it is set by hand.
ref_text: The bench outside the stall is warm from the afternoon. A kettle hisses, a cyclist rings his bell, and somebody laughs at the next table.

lines.text: You're looking for the man with the mole. His cap is maroon.
One of these three is him.
She swore all three caps were black.
Then the stall switched its bulb on.
Number two. Maroon, the whole time.
If you picked him, you guessed.
A cap doesn't glow. You only see the part of the light it throws back.
That sign makes almost no red, so a maroon cap has nothing to throw back. It turns black.
She wasn't lying. The sign was.
